meta.name: init-onecli
meta.description: Install and initialize OneCLI Agent Vault. Migrates existing .env credentials to the vault. Use after /update-nanoclaw brings in OneCLI as a breaking change, or for first-time OneCLI setup.

copy.tagline: 把散落在 .env 里的密钥搬进统一保险库,并完成命令行工具的首次初始化配置
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你刚装好命令行工具,想把项目里的密钥从 .env 收进保险库
copy.tagline_en: Migrate scattered .env credentials into a managed vault and finish first-time setup
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just installed a CLI tool and want its .env secrets moved into a vault

howto.what: 帮你安装并初始化 OneCLI Agent Vault:配置网关、把 .env 里的 Anthropic 等凭据迁进保险库、重启服务并查看日志确认生效。之后容器里的 agent 不再直接读到原始密钥。
howto.when: 在 /update-nanoclaw 因破坏性变更引入 OneCLI 之后,或首次从零搭建 OneCLI 时使用;若代码库还没接入 OneCLI,会先让你跑 /update-nanoclaw。

howto.what_en: Installs and initializes OneCLI Agent Vault: configures the gateway, migrates credentials (such as Anthropic keys) from .env into the vault, restarts the service, and checks logs. Container agents then no longer see raw keys.
howto.when_en: Use after /update-nanoclaw introduces OneCLI as a breaking change, or for first-time OneCLI setup. If the codebase doesn't yet expect OneCLI, it first asks you to run /update-nanoclaw.
